messages:
Alex: Hey team — we need to lock a design review for the combined API + SDK + Console UX RFC. Trying to minimize rework by doing one session that covers surface, SDK ergonomics, and the console flows. Proposed slots (PT): Wed 10:00, Thu 16:00, Fri 11:00. Pre-read is here: https://docs.internal/redwood/rfcs/api-sdk-console-rfc (please skim the summary section)

Maria: ACK. I prefer Thu 16:00. I can do Wed early but Thu late is best for PM/UX folks.

Sam: Thu 16:00 works for infra and runtime. Heads-up: we need to reserve a review room with A/V for screen-share and live demo of the stubbed runtime.

Jin: Thu 16 also works for me. Quick ask — can folks add 2-3 acceptance scenarios they care about in the doc under "Review focus"? Means we'll have concrete pass/fail for the UX and API.

Alex: Good call, Jin. I'll add a short checklist — please paste any scenarios you want me to fold in.

Priya: Thu 16 is ok but I'm on the customer call until 16:30 PT. If we do Thu 16:00 I might join ~16:40. If critical, pick Fri 11:00.

Maria: Hmm — in that case maybe Wed 10:00 is safest for full attendance? Anyone blocked Wed 10?

Sam: Wed 10 conflicts with our weekly infra sync. We could move infra sync that week? Not ideal but possible.

Alex: Quick poll: Wed 10 = full infra conflict, Fri 11 = Priya good, Thu 16 = most available but Priya joins late. Thoughts?

Jin: I'm flexible. If we can get Priya for at least the first 25–30 minutes (to cover compliance + data handling bits), Thu is fine. If not, pick Fri.

Maria: Can we do Thu 16:30 instead? That might let Priya join. But Sam / infra team?

Sam: Thu 16:30 is ok for infra. I can nudge the infra folks. If we go Thu 16:30, can we keep it to 60 minutes and focus on the three big items: 1) API surface + versioning, 2) SDK ergonomics and auth, 3) console flows + templates.

Alex: OK provisional: Thu 16:30 PT, 60m, agenda below. If no objections by EOD I'll send calendar invite. Agenda (short):

```
1) 5m - Quick context + goals (Alex)
2) 20m - API surface & versioning (Maria)
3) 15m - SDK ergonomics & example flows (Sam)
4) 15m - Console UX walkthrough & templates (Priya)
5) 5m - Action items & rollouts/canary plan
```

Alex: Pre-read checklist (please mark done in the doc):
- [ ] Read RFC summary + decision rationale
- [ ] Add 1-3 acceptance scenarios under "Review focus"
- [ ] Flag any hard constraints (latency SLO, auth, data residency)
- [ ] Add example code snippet for desired SDK call in either JS/Python

Maria: I'll add the API examples and call out versioning tradeoffs.

Priya: I'll add console screenshots and two customer scenarios.

Sam: I'll paste the runtime demo steps + a small script to reproduce perf numbers:
```
# run locally
python perf_demo.py --model small --seq 512 --batch 8
```

Alex: Also adding a short rollback/canary checklist for post-review:
- single-region canary with 10% traffic
- health checks and latency SLO monitor
- auto-fallback to previous model variant on error rates > 1%

Jin: Can someone file the RFC PR for the console changes? I can review API bits once PR is open.

Alex: Maria, can you open the console RFC PR by EOD tomorrow?

Maria: Yep will open PR and ping here. PR number will be linked in the doc.

calendar-bot: Created event "Design review: API/SDK/Console RFC" Thu 16:30 PT — invites pending.

Priya: Thanks — calendar invite looks good. One more ask: can we ensure the meeting notes template includes action owners + expected delivery dates? That really helps follow-ups.

Alex: Yep. I'll use the standard meeting-notes template and add an action owner table.

Sam: Last thing — if anyone has blockers for the pre-read (e.g., access to the internal doc or demo infra), ping me directly and I'll sort it out.

Alex: Great — if no objections I’ll finalize and send invites by EOD. :thumbsup:
